gloss: to glare; to give a piercing look; to stare sharply

definitions.gloss: to glare; to give a piercing look; to stare sharply
definitions.explanation: To look at someone with a single, sharp, intentional gaze that conveys displeasure, suspicion, or intimidation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ジロリと{見|み}られた。
examples.english: The teacher gave me a sharp look.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}して→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ジロリ→ジロリ：11020_jirori⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: When I came in late, the boss shot me a glare.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大声|おおごえ}→大声：09592_oogoe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}していたら→話す：00467_hanasu⟧、⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ジロリと{見|み}られて⟦{恥|は}ずかしく→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I was talking loudly on the train, a nearby passenger glared at me and I felt embarrassed.

notes:
Combines the onomatopoeia ⟦ジロリ→ジロリ：11020_jirori⟧ (a sharp, sudden gaze) with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look). ⟦ジロリ→ジロリ：11020_jirori⟧ captures a single, deliberate glance — quick but intense, carrying clear disapproval or warning. Written in katakana to emphasize the mimetic quality.

USAGE:
⟦ジロリ→ジロリ：11020_jirori⟧ describes a momentary look, unlike ジロジロ (repeated staring). One glare from the corner of the eye is ⟦ジロリ→ジロリ：11020_jirori⟧; sustained, uncomfortable staring is ジロジロ.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ジロリと{見|み}る: to glare at
- ジロリと{見|み}られる: to be glared at (passive)
- ⟦ジロリ→ジロリ：11020_jirori⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{睨|にら}む→睨む：02136_niramu⟧: to glare menacingly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ジロジロ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to stare rudely — repeated, sustained, and rude staring
- ⟦{睨|にら}む→睨む：02136_niramu⟧: to glare; to stare down — a more intense, hostile gaze
- チラリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to glance briefly — a quick look without the negative nuance
- ⟦じっと{見|み}る→じっと見る：26091_jittomiru⟧: to gaze fixedly — sustained looking, but not necessarily hostile
